careers.title: Software / Computer Engineer
careers.exam: JEE Main + JEE Advanced (for IITs) or state CETs for B.Tech CSE/IT
careers.syllabus: 4-year B.Tech: Programming, DSA, Computer Networks, DBMS, OS, AI/ML electives
careers.scope: IT services, product companies, startups, freelancing, remote global jobs
careers.future: High demand, AI/ML and cloud skills increasing value further
careers.example: Basically the person who fixes it when the app crashes at 2 AM and everyone's yelling in the group chat. Also the person who gets paid the most to say 'it's not a bug, it's a feature.' 💻
careers.description: Day-to-day, you write and test code, fix bugs, attend daily stand-up meetings, and build features for websites/apps. Most work is on a laptop, often remote-friendly, in small teams.

careers.title: Government Engineer (PSU / Railways / Defence)
careers.exam: GATE (for PSUs like ONGC, NTPC), SSC JE, RRB JE, ESE (Engineering Services Exam via UPSC)
careers.syllabus: Core branch subjects (Mechanical/Civil/Electrical/CS) + General Studies for ESE
careers.scope: PSUs, Indian Railways, Defence R&D (DRDO), state engineering services
careers.salary_senior: ₹15-25 LPA at senior levels + full govt benefits
careers.future: Stable, less growth speed than private but high job security
careers.example: Think: the engineer who makes sure the train doesn't randomly decide to take a detour into a field. Job security level: 'even a zombie apocalypse probably won't fire you.' 🚂
careers.description: You inspect, maintain, and approve technical projects — could be checking railway tracks, running a power plant unit, or overseeing construction quality. Mix of desk work and on-site inspection.

careers.title: Data Scientist / AI Engineer
careers.exam: B.Tech entrance (JEE) then specialization via electives/certifications
careers.syllabus: Statistics, Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Engineering
careers.scope: Tech companies, fintech, healthcare AI, research labs
careers.future: One of the fastest growing fields globally, very high future scope
careers.example: The wizard behind Instagram knowing you want shoes before you do. Builds the algorithm, gets the LPA, occasionally questions if AI will take their own job someday. 🤖
careers.description: You analyze large datasets, build prediction models, and work closely with product teams to turn data into decisions — like figuring out which customers might cancel a subscription.

careers.title: NDA / Indian Armed Forces (Technical)
careers.exam: NDA exam (after 12th) or CDS (after graduation)
careers.syllabus: Maths, English, General Knowledge + SSB interview (personality assessment)
careers.scope: Army, Navy, Air Force technical branches
careers.salary_senior: Senior officer ranks ₹2 LPA+/month + full benefits
careers.future: Respected career, stable, but demanding lifestyle
careers.example: Wakes up at 4 AM for a run while you're still dreaming about breakfast. Free housing, uniform swag, and the kind of respect that makes uncles at weddings salute you. 🫡
careers.description: Physical training, technical operations of equipment/vehicles/weapons systems, leading soldiers, and being posted to different locations across the country (or borders) every few years.

careers.title: DRDO Scientist
careers.exam: DRDO SET / GATE-based recruitment
careers.syllabus: Core engineering subjects + specialization in defence tech
careers.scope: Missile tech, aerospace, weapons R&D
careers.future: Strong scope given India's defence push, prestigious
careers.example: Literally builds missiles for a living and still can't tell you why the wifi router in their own house doesn't work. 🚀
careers.description: Research and development on defence technology — could be missile systems, radar, or materials science. Lab-based work with long-term research projects, often classified.

careers.title: Architect
careers.exam: NATA or JEE Main Paper 2 (for B.Arch)
careers.syllabus: 5-year B.Arch: Design studio, building construction, structures, urban planning
careers.scope: Private firms, own practice, government urban planning bodies (CPWD, town planning depts)
careers.salary_senior: ₹15-40 LPA (own practice can be much higher)
careers.future: Growing with urbanization, sustainable design is a rising niche
careers.example: The person your family calls when deciding 'kitchen idhar rakhe ya wahan.' Draws your dream house, then watches you change the plan five times. 🏗️
careers.description: You meet clients, design buildings/spaces, create blueprints using software like AutoCAD, visit construction sites, and coordinate with engineers and contractors.

careers.title: Research Scientist (Physics/Chemistry/Maths)
careers.exam: IIT-JAM / CSIR-NET / GATE for M.Sc-PhD track, then ISRO/BARC/CSIR recruitment
careers.syllabus: B.Sc + M.Sc in core science, then PhD research
careers.scope: ISRO, BARC, CSIR labs, university research, teaching
careers.future: India investing heavily in space & nuclear research, good long-term scope
careers.example: Sends rockets to the moon for less budget than a Bollywood movie. Low-key national hero, high-key still uses a 2015 laptop. 🛰️
careers.description: Lab experiments, data analysis, writing research papers, and presenting findings at conferences. Often based at a research institute or university, working on a specific research problem for years.

careers.title: Doctor (MBBS)
careers.exam: NEET-UG (for MBBS admission), then NEET-PG for specialization
careers.syllabus: 5.5 year MBBS: Anatomy, Physiology, Pathology, Clinical subjects + 1 year internship
careers.scope: Government hospitals, private hospitals, own clinic, specialization abroad
careers.future: Always in demand, specialization (surgery, cardiology etc.) increases scope a lot
careers.example: The relative every family group chat forwards medical memes to for 'confirmation.' Saves lives, also somehow always on call during Diwali. 🩺
careers.description: Examining patients, diagnosing illnesses, prescribing treatment, performing procedures (depending on specialization), and long hospital shifts including night duty.

careers.title: Government Medical Officer
careers.exam: NEET-UG + state PSC medical officer recruitment exams
careers.syllabus: MBBS + state health department protocols
careers.scope: Primary Health Centres, District Hospitals, Army Medical Corps
careers.future: High stability, govt pushing rural healthcare expansion
careers.example: The doctor treating an entire village while riding a government jeep down a road that's 40% pothole. Certified legend status. 🚑
careers.description: Running a Primary Health Centre or hospital ward, treating a high volume of patients, managing government health programs (vaccination drives etc.), often in rural postings initially.

careers.title: Pharmacist
careers.exam: State CETs for B.Pharm, GPAT for M.Pharm
careers.syllabus: 4-year B.Pharm: Pharmacology, Pharmaceutics, Drug chemistry
careers.scope: Hospitals, pharma companies, own pharmacy, govt drug regulatory bodies
careers.future: Steady demand, pharma industry growing in India
careers.example: Can read a doctor's handwriting that looks like an ECG report. Genuinely a superpower at this point. 💊
careers.description: Dispensing medicines, checking prescriptions for errors, advising patients on dosage, and managing pharmacy inventory — either in a hospital, retail pharmacy, or pharma company.

careers.title: Nursing (B.Sc Nursing)
careers.exam: NEET or state nursing entrance exams
careers.syllabus: 4-year B.Sc Nursing: Anatomy, patient care, clinical practice
careers.scope: Hospitals in India and abroad (very high international demand)
careers.salary_entry: ₹3-5 LPA (India), much higher abroad (Gulf, UK, Australia)
careers.future: Extremely high global demand, strong option for going abroad
careers.example: Runs on 3 hours of sleep and pure willpower, gives injections painlessly (unlike your school compounder). Also your ticket to working in London or Dubai. ✈️
careers.description: Direct patient care — administering medicines, monitoring vitals, assisting doctors during procedures, and providing emotional support to patients and families. Shift-based work.

careers.title: Biotechnologist / Research Scientist
careers.exam: CUET/state CETs for B.Tech/B.Sc Biotech, then CSIR-NET/GATE for research
careers.syllabus: Genetics, molecular biology, bioinformatics, lab techniques
careers.scope: Pharma R&D, govt research labs (ICMR, DBT), biotech startups
careers.future: Genomics and biotech are rapidly growing fields in India
careers.example: Spends 8 hours a day looking at things under a microscope that are smaller than your problems, but somehow more interesting. 🔬
careers.description: Lab work involving genetic engineering, cell cultures, or drug development, plus data analysis and documentation. Could be in a pharma company or a research institute.

careers.title: Chartered Accountant (CA)
careers.exam: CA Foundation, Intermediate, Final (ICAI exams) + articleship
careers.syllabus: Accounting, Taxation, Auditing, Law, Financial Management
careers.scope: Own practice, corporate finance roles, Big 4 firms, CFO track
careers.future: Always in demand, GST/taxation complexity increases need
careers.example: The one relative who actually understands your father's tax filing panic every March. Also has legendary 'I survived CA Final' trauma stories. 📊
careers.description: Auditing company accounts, filing taxes, financial planning for clients or your firm, and ensuring legal compliance. Heavy workload especially around tax filing season (March-July).

careers.title: Bank PO / Government Banking
careers.exam: IBPS PO, SBI PO, RBI Grade B
careers.syllabus: Quant, Reasoning, English, Banking Awareness, Economics (for RBI)
careers.scope: Public sector banks, RBI, NABARD
careers.future: Stable career, RBI Grade B especially prestigious
careers.example: Stamps your passbook with the power and confidence of a Supreme Court judge. Lunch break is sacred, do not disturb. 🏦
careers.description: Handling customer transactions, loan approvals, managing bank branch operations, and later moving into policy/managerial roles. Regular office hours, public sector job security.

careers.title: Investment Banker / Financial Analyst
careers.exam: B.Com/BBA + CFA or MBA Finance (via CAT/other MBA entrances)
careers.syllabus: Financial modeling, valuation, equity research, corporate finance
careers.scope: Investment banks, private equity, hedge funds, corporate finance
careers.future: High reward, competitive, growing with India's capital markets
careers.example: Builds Excel sheets so complex NASA would be impressed. Sleeps 4 hours, earns like they sleep 12. 📈
careers.description: Building financial models, valuing companies, preparing pitch decks for mergers/acquisitions or IPOs. Extremely long hours (60-80/week common) but high pay.

careers.title: SSC CGL (Various Govt Departments)
careers.exam: SSC CGL (Staff Selection Commission - Combined Graduate Level)
careers.syllabus: Quant, Reasoning, English, General Awareness
careers.scope: Income Tax dept, Central Excise, Audit, CBI, various ministries
careers.future: Wide variety of postings, stable government career
careers.example: One exam, and suddenly you could end up literally anywhere in India — Income Tax, CBI, who knows. Life becomes an unpredictable adventure with a govt ID card. 🎲
careers.description: Depends entirely on the department you're posted to — could be tax assessment (Income Tax), customs inspection, or administrative work in a ministry. Desk-based government office work.

careers.title: Business Manager / MBA roles
careers.exam: CAT/XAT/other MBA entrance exams after BBA/B.Com
careers.syllabus: Marketing, Operations, HR, Strategy, Finance (2-year MBA)
careers.scope: Corporate management, consulting, own business/startup
careers.future: Consulting and product management roles growing fast
careers.example: Turns 'let's circle back on this' into an entire career. Wears a blazer to a Zoom call from the waist up only. 💼
careers.description: Managing teams or projects, setting strategy, coordinating between departments, presenting to leadership. Varies hugely by industry — from FMCG brand management to tech product management.

careers.title: IAS / IPS / IFS (UPSC Civil Services)
careers.exam: UPSC CSE (Prelims, Mains, Interview) — any graduation stream eligible
careers.syllabus: General Studies, Optional subject, Essay, Current Affairs
careers.scope: District administration, policy making, police leadership, foreign service
careers.salary_entry: ₹8-10 LPA + govt housing, staff, high social status
careers.salary_senior: ₹20 LPA+ + extensive perks at Secretary level
careers.future: Among most prestigious careers in India, very competitive
careers.example: Your whole village throws a party bigger than your wedding when you clear this. Gets a govt bungalow before turning 30. Absolute chad energy. 🏛️
careers.description: IAS: running district administration, implementing government policy, handling law & order. IPS: leading police forces. IFS: representing India in embassies abroad. High responsibility, high visibility roles.

careers.title: State PSC Services
careers.exam: State Public Service Commission exams (similar pattern to UPSC)
careers.syllabus: General studies + state-specific topics
careers.scope: State administrative services, state police services
careers.future: Good alternative to UPSC, less competition per seat
careers.example: Basically UPSC's cool regional cousin — same respect, slightly less insane competition. 📋
careers.description: Similar to IAS/IPS but at the state level — managing state government departments, local administration, or state police divisions.

careers.title: Lawyer / Advocate
careers.exam: CLAT (for 5-year integrated LLB) or LLB after graduation
careers.syllabus: Constitutional law, Criminal law, Civil law, Contract law, moot courts
careers.scope: Litigation, corporate law firms, own practice
careers.salary_entry: ₹5-15 LPA (top law firms), variable for litigation
careers.future: Corporate law and IP law are fast-growing niches
careers.example: Says 'objection!' in real life during family arguments. Reads contracts for fun, judges your rental agreement silently. ⚖️
careers.description: Representing clients in court, drafting contracts and legal documents, researching case law, and negotiating settlements. Litigation lawyers spend a lot of time in courtrooms; corporate lawyers mostly in offices.

careers.title: Judiciary (Judge)
careers.exam: State Judicial Services Exam (after LLB)
careers.syllabus: Law subjects + state judicial procedures
careers.scope: Civil judge, district judge, career track to High Court
careers.salary_senior: ₹25 LPA+ at High Court judge level
careers.future: Highly respected, stable government legal career
careers.example: Literally 'Your Honour' now. Everyone stands up when they walk into a room. Peak respect unlocked. 👨‍⚖️
careers.description: Presiding over court cases, hearing arguments from both sides, studying case files, and delivering judgments based on law. Starts as a civil judge, career progresses to higher courts.

careers.title: UI/UX Designer
careers.exam: Portfolio-based / design college entrances (NID DAT, UCEED)
careers.syllabus: Design thinking, user research, prototyping tools (Figma etc.)
careers.scope: Tech companies, design agencies, freelancing
careers.future: High demand as every company needs digital products
careers.example: Gets personally offended by a badly aligned button. Argues with developers about '2 pixels' like it's a matter of national security. 🎨
careers.description: Researching how users interact with an app/website, sketching wireframes, creating polished designs in tools like Figma, and testing designs with real users before handing off to developers.

careers.title: Journalist / Mass Communication
careers.exam: University entrance exams for BA/MA Journalism & Mass Comm
careers.syllabus: Reporting, editing, media law, digital media production
careers.scope: News channels, digital media, PR, content creation
careers.future: Digital/content creation space growing fast alongside traditional media
careers.example: Shows up to a flood with a mic, standing in water up to their knees, saying 'as you can see behind me...' Absolute dedication. 🎤
careers.description: Researching and writing news stories, interviewing people, fact-checking, and meeting tight deadlines. Could be field reporting, desk editing, or on-camera anchoring.

careers.title: Government School Teacher
careers.exam: CTET/State TET + B.Ed
careers.syllabus: Subject knowledge + B.Ed (child psychology, pedagogy)
careers.scope: Government schools, job security, long vacations
careers.future: Stable, consistent demand across India
careers.example: Can silence an entire classroom with just a look. Two months of summer vacation while you're still stuck at your desk job. Iconic. 📚
careers.description: Planning lessons, teaching classes, grading assignments, and managing classroom discipline. Government schools also involve some administrative and exam-invigilation duties.

careers.title: Psychologist / Counsellor
careers.exam: BA/MA Psychology, then RCI registration for clinical practice
careers.syllabus: Human behavior, counseling techniques, clinical psychology
careers.scope: Hospitals, schools, corporate wellness, private practice
careers.future: Mental health awareness rising fast, growing demand
careers.example: Everyone's unofficial free therapist at parties, except now they actually get paid for it. 'And how does that make you feel?' 🧠
careers.description: One-on-one or group therapy sessions, listening to clients, developing coping strategies, and sometimes working with schools or companies on mental wellness programs.

careers.title: ITI Electrician / Fitter / Mechanic
careers.exam: Direct ITI admission (after 10th) — no entrance exam, merit-based
careers.syllabus: 2-year practical trade training: wiring, machinery, tools, safety
careers.scope: Factories, PSUs (via apprenticeship), private workshops, own shop, Gulf jobs
careers.salary_senior: ₹6-12 LPA (skilled supervisor level or own business)
careers.future: India's manufacturing push (Make in India) is creating huge skilled-trade demand
careers.example: The person your entire building calls when the inverter dies during a power cut. Genuinely a household hero, no cape needed. 🔧
careers.description: Hands-on technical work — wiring buildings, repairing machinery, or fixing vehicles, depending on your trade. Mostly on-site or workshop-based, practical daily tasks.

careers.title: Polytechnic Diploma Engineer
careers.exam: State Polytechnic entrance / merit-based after 10th
careers.syllabus: 3-year diploma: core trade subjects, practical labs, on-site training
careers.scope: Junior engineer roles in construction, manufacturing, or further study into B.Tech via lateral entry
careers.salary_senior: ₹10-15 LPA (with experience, or after upgrading to B.Tech)
careers.future: Solid fast-track option — 3 years and you're already earning, or you can upgrade later
careers.example: Skips the whole '4 years of theory' drama and gets hands-on way faster. The shortcut everyone wishes they knew about in 10th grade. ⚙️
careers.description: Assisting on construction sites or in factories under senior engineers, doing technical drawings, quality checks, and hands-on supervision of junior technical staff.

careers.title: Agricultural Scientist (ICAR)
careers.exam: ICAR AIEEA (for B.Sc Agriculture), then ICAR-NET/ASRB for scientist roles
careers.syllabus: 4-year B.Sc Agriculture: soil science, crop production, plant genetics
careers.scope: ICAR institutes, state agriculture departments, agri-research
careers.future: Climate-resilient farming and food security make this increasingly critical
careers.example: Basically a doctor, but for crops. Diagnoses why your tomato plant looks sad and depressed. 🌾
careers.description: Conducting field trials on crops, researching pest-resistant seed varieties, advising farmers on best practices, and publishing agricultural research.

careers.title: Agribusiness Manager
careers.exam: B.Sc Agriculture + MBA in Agribusiness (via CAT/state MBA entrances)
careers.syllabus: Farm economics, supply chain, agri-marketing, food processing
careers.scope: Agri companies, food processing firms, agri-tech startups
careers.future: Agri-tech and food supply chain startups booming in India right now
careers.example: Figures out how mangoes go from a farm in Ratnagiri to your fridge in Delhi without turning into juice on the way. Logistics wizardry. 🥭
careers.description: Managing supply chains from farm to market, coordinating with farmers and distributors, running agri-marketing campaigns, and handling logistics for food/agri products.
